Use `snl entry-package export` to produce a portable export of one Entry Package after it validates.

### Availability
This Entry is a normative product contract. The command is implemented only when its canonical path appears in machine-readable `snl --help`; absence means planned and unavailable, never silently emulated through a different command.


### Command path
`entry-package/export` is the canonical transport-neutral command. The intended shell spelling is `snl entry-package export`. Current availability is advertised by machine-readable `snl --help`; an Agent/MCP adapter submits the same operation object instead of reconstructing shell text.

### Operation request
```json
{"protocol":"snl.operation/v1","command":"entry-package/export","root":"/absolute/workspace","arguments":{"id":"<exact-id>","format":"json"}}
```
Every adapter accepts exactly this semantic request. Unknown argument keys are rejected. The CLI accepts `--root` and `--json` globally and emits one complete JSON document followed by a newline. Export closure includes required referenced metadata; unsupported/lossy formats fail closed. Under `--json`, artifact bytes are returned inside `data.artifact`; shell `--output <file>` is adapter-only, writes atomically, and `--output -` is rejected.

### Success result
A successful call exits `0` and returns `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":true,"command":"entry-package/export","data":{},"diagnostics":[]}`. `data.artifact` contains the deterministic self-describing export with media type, encoding, and digest; with shell `--output <file>`, `data` instead identifies the atomically published path and digest.

### Failure and exit semantics
Domain rejection (invalid data, not-found, conflict, or validation errors) exits `1`. Invocation, input I/O, unsupported workspace/schema, lock acquisition, and runtime failures exit `2`. Failure stdout under `--json` is exactly one `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":false,"command":"entry-package/export","error":{"code":"<stable-code>","message":"<actionable text>","details":{},"retryable":false}}`; no stack trace or prose contaminates stdout.

### State and concurrency
Read-only with respect to the workspace. Explicit output-file writes must be exclusive/atomic and never modify `.SNL_Doc`. Revisions, cursors, checked digests, and workspace revisions are opaque tokens. Repeated calls against unchanged bytes return equivalent semantic results.
